title: GTA 6 Box Copies Begin Arriving Early with Online Feature and New Screenshots
description: Physical GTA 6 copies are arriving at retailers November 12, with a 230GB install size and an online functions icon, while new screenshots showcase Lucia, Jason and a plane.
youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Box Copies Arrive Early with Online Feature and New Screenshots
socialHook: GTA 6 physical copies are hitting retailers starting November 12, ahead of the November 19 launch.

sections.heading: Release Timeline and Box Copy Distribution
paragraphs: According to the RockstarINTEL report, physical copies of GTA 6 have started arriving at major retailers on November 12, with retailers expected to list the discs for sale beginning November 19, the official launch date.

Take-Two and Rockstar confirmed that the game cases were shipped to stores and some staff posted images showing the back cover, which lists a 230GB installation requirement and an online functions icon.

sections.heading: New Screenshots and Online Feature Insights
paragraphs: The article includes three newly released screenshots depicting the protagonists Lucia and Jason alongside a plane flying over the Keys, providing the first real‑world visual glimpse of the game's characters and environment.

An icon indicating online functions on the case suggests either a forthcoming update to GTA Online next year or the ability to purchase the Ultimate Edition upgrade directly from within the game, though Rockstar has not clarified the exact purpose.
